newsitem.title: USA: Continental to buy Boeing jets - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Continental to buy Boeing jets - NYT.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc is expected to announce plans to buy 35 wide-body jets from Boeing Co, the New York Times said.
In Tuesday's edition, the Times said the jets would be purchased under an exclusive arrangement with Boeing, making Continental the third U.S. airline to set up such a deal.
Continental is expected to make Boeing its sole supplier over the next 20 years, joining AMR Corp's American Airlines and Delta Air Lines Inc in similar arrangements.
Continental is expected to buy five Boeing 777s and 30 of its 767s. Based on list prices, the order is worth about $3 billion.
